mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_file (knowledge_base_id, ingestion_batch_id, logical_document_key, original_file_name, file_type, source_kind, language_code, sha256, file_size_bytes, parser_version, status) VALUES (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{ingestionBatchId}, #{logicalDocumentKey}, #{originalFileName}, #{fileType}, #{sourceKind}, #{languageCode}, #{sha256}, #{fileSizeBytes}, #{parserVersion}, 'PARSED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ingestion_batch_id = IF(#{refreshRegistration}, VALUES(ingestion_batch_id), ingestion_batch_id), logical_document_key = IF(#{refreshRegistration}, VALUES(logical_document_key), logical_document_key), parser_version = VALUES(parser_version), status = 'PARSED'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM source_file WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND sha256 = #{sha256}
mapper.update: UPDATE source_file SET status = 'VALIDATED' WHERE id = #{sourceFileId}
UPDATE source_file SET status = 'VALIDATED' WHERE ingestion_batch_id = #{batchId}
